confidence_notes: Crowdsourced prices near July support the meal, cappuccino and draft beer estimates. Cocktail and wine estimates use local price premiums over beer from limited bar data. Lodging is modeled, with the greatest uncertainty for hostel beds and private rooms. comparable_city_reasoning: Kilifi and Diani provide a coastal Kenya benchmark for lodging, with modest guesthouse prices and higher July demand near beaches.
